baseline.publication: No version change, commit, tag, push or deployment.

scope.meaning: Cold DropNew admission through memory/unread/live publication and queued SQL; deletion/settings/private replacement rebasing; writer producer lifetime and healthy drain.
scope.boundaries: Service-level synthetic events and a disposable PostgreSQL 16.15 cluster via a private Unix socket; fresh EventBus state against retained fixture rows, not a process crash.
excluded: live Engine/Agent, SSH/LAN or kernel mutation

findings.summary: Cold DropNew used only memory occupancy and broadcast events later rejected by a full or nearly-full SQL history.
reproductions: 48 durable rows accepted 10 publications with only 2 slots
40 durable rows accepted 30 concurrent publications with only 10 slots
findings.fix: Per-owner durable baseline plus locally admitted pending events, independent of the writer's expiring count cache; capacity checked before visible changes, all publication locks before reserving; mutations invalidate after ordered barriers.

findings.summary: The persistence worker's own sender kept the queue alive after all external producers left.
reproductions: disabled queue rejected its barrier but did not exit
127 queued events reached retention checks but the worker did not exit
findings.fix: The worker relinquishes its producer handle on entry, allowing healthy remaining batches to drain and state to be released while the runtime remains alive.

tdd.authoring_diagnostics: Two test-authoring compiler errors were corrected before runtime red evidence; retained separately and not counted as reproduced defects.
tdd.after_fix_guards: One new ordinary capacity-lock cancellation case and a one-second pending-capacity expiry extension were added after the first green run.

post_documentation_preflight.meaning: Rechecked final documentation mirrors, length/version/OpenAPI/API/SDK/CI selection and formatter/tool fixtures after results were recorded. Runtime code was unchanged from the full gate.

quality_gate.compatibility: OpenAPI, API and SDK generation/surface checks passed at unchanged version 0.4.0
quality_gate.note: Common distribution/SSH/kernel-smoke scripts are isolated tool fixtures, not deployment or privileged kernel acceptance.

event_postgres.command: env -u DATABASE_URL CYANREX_DB_FALLBACK=true CYANREX_TEST_DATABASE_URL=<explicit disposable private socket URL> cargo test --manifest-path engine/Cargo.toml --locked --lib services::event_bus::tests -- --ignored --nocapture --test-threads=1

preservation.note: Original inventory and historical pass 01-08 reports/logs/mirrors remain byte-identical, including captured whitespace.

limitations: Single EventBus clones only, not external SQL writers or cross-Engine reservations; metadata remains until service destruction.
Cold recreation is not process crash, lost-commit or power-loss recovery.
Healthy queued drain assumes a living runtime; no process shutdown hook or whole-worker write deadline.
Stalled SQL, ambiguous retry duplication and lost commit acknowledgements remain untested.
Count failures keep existing latched volatile fallback; restoration does not reconcile volatile events.
History/export/unread read failures retain existing fallback behavior; snapshots can trail live delivery.
No new event IDs, cursor replay, exactly-once semantics, aggregate byte/owner quotas or durable HTTP success guarantee.
next: F32/F34 selected-storage read failure honesty, filter boundaries, and restart/fallback consistency using only isolated fixtures.
